sections: AECN Rail — Basis for Loaded Mass (Week 3, INJ-09-2026-W3)
vvb_guidance.scope_quote: The basis described here applies to Week 3 of this Reporting Period, INJ-09-2026-W3, covering 11 – 18 September 2026, and to that week alone. For all other weeks in this Reporting Period, the mass loaded at origin is taken from the metric-tons figure stated on the Bill of Lading.
vvb_guidance.offloaded_mass_quote: Mass offloaded at the injection site is measured independently, by certified truck scale, as the difference between full and empty weights for each offload. Sparging and filtration losses are deducted from the offloaded mass to give the Mass of Bio-Oil Injected, which is subtracted directly from the railcar's loaded mass.
vvb_guidance.multi_week_quote: Where a railcar is offloaded across more than one reporting week, the loaded mass is recorded once, in the week the railcar's first offload occurs, and subsequent weeks draw against the same shipment.
vvb_guidance.w2_coverage_check: The document names no INJ-09-2026-W2 offload, railcar TIMX201060 / SHPX215079 / SHPX215046 or truck BOL 2499-T / 2503-T / 2505-T, and contains no standard-tare, missing-ticket or mislabeled-ticket statement. It offers no coverage for the TIMX201060 offload 2 ticket gap or the SHPX215046 M12 note.
vvb_guidance.august_standard_tare_trigger_quote: substitute the standard empty weight for the trailer recorded on the Full ticket when either (a) the empty scale ticket is missing, or (b) the empty ticket's tractor and/or trailer do not match the Full ticket. Substituted values are annotated in the ops-notes Empty Scale Ticket cell.
vvb_guidance.august_railcar_loss_band_quote: Every other railcar offloaded in the same week falls between -101.75 kg and +480.59 kg.
vvb_guidance.spill_check: Neither guidance document discloses a spill involving TIMX201060, SHPX215079 or SHPX215046.

TIMX201060.notes_M: New arrival this RP (7.31.2026 load). Loaded 7/29-7/30/2026 at SOPOR (BOLs 2450-R/2451-R/2452-R, 78,140 kg). All 4 offloads logged this week, CAT scale-ticket confirmed (delta 0.00 kg vs COBB on all 4). Prior-RP claimed: 0 kg.

SHPX215079.notes_M: New arrival this RP (8.4.2026 load). Loaded 7/30 and 8/3/2026 at SOPOR (BOLs 2453-R/2454-R/2455-R, 77,870 kg). Offloads 1-2 logged this week, CAT scale-ticket confirmed (delta 0.00 kg vs COBB on both). Prior-RP claimed: 0 kg. Note: this physical railcar had an earlier, separate 6.18.2026 loading/offload cycle already closed in a prior RP -- not part of this arrival mass balance.

SHPX215046.notes_M: Loaded 8/5-8/6/2026 at SOPOR (BOLs 2462-R/2463-R/2464-R, 77,680 kg). COBB contains ONLY offload_3 (20,810.80 kg) and offload_4 (14,821.22 kg) for this arrival -- offload_1 and offload_2 do not exist in COBB; status pending confirmation, not assumed lost. LD3 only candidate CAT ticket (1124426250545, 74,320 lb, 9-07-26) is confirmed mislabeled (printed SHPX215046OFFLOAD3, actually belongs to another car per Garrett); its next-best mass-fit alternative is itself a ticket labeled GPRX5107 (a different, W1 railcar) -- not treated as genuine. LD4 has no resolvable ticket after a wide Gmail harvest. Both LD3 and LD4 Full/Empty left blank pending real tickets. 45.9 pct of loaded mass currently documented (35,632.02 / 77,680 kg) -- Loss suppressed by design (>=95pct closure guard) until resolved. Prior-RP claimed: 0 kg.
SHPX215046.notes_M_contradictions: Row 28 (offload 3) IS populated with ticket 1124426250545 (74,320 lb), the very ticket M12 calls 'confirmed mislabeled ... not treated as genuine', and row 29 (offload 4) is populated with 61,980 / 29,260 lb although M12 says 'LD4 has no resolvable ticket' and 'Both LD3 and LD4 Full/Empty left blank'. M12's 35,632.02 kg documented figure also differs from F12 35,652.3312 kg. COBB now holds offload_1 (21,055.74064 kg) and offload_2 (20,992.23776 kg) under INJ-09-2026-W3_bio_oil (rows 850-851), so 'do not exist in COBB' is also out of date.
